# [\#](https://the-odds-api.com/features/spreadsheets.html\#page-frontmatter-title) Sports Odds Data for Google Sheets

Get live sports odds data in Google Sheets at the click of a button
with the [The Odds API add-on(opens new window)](https://workspace.google.com/marketplace/app/sports_odds_plus/648207346109).

No programming skills needed!

![Sports odds data in Google Sheets](https://the-odds-api.com/assets/img/sports-odds-in-sheets.gif)

Get Add On →

Select the sport and region you want to see,
and watch your spreadsheet populate with current sports odds data from different bookmakers.

Sports odds data covers live and upcoming sports games for several bookmakers.
To learn more about the sports and bookmakers we cover, [see here](https://the-odds-api.com/).

Prefer Microsoft Excel?

Check out the [Excel add-on](https://the-odds-api.com/features/excel.html)

## [\#](https://the-odds-api.com/features/spreadsheets.html\#get-started) Get Started

You'll need

1. A Live Odds API Key ( [start for free](https://the-odds-api.com/))

2. The Google Sheets add-on ( [free download(opens new window)](https://workspace.google.com/marketplace/app/sports_odds_plus/648207346109))


And that's it. Get started today!

![Works with google drive](https://the-odds-api.com/assets/img/works-with-google-drive-white.png)
